title: no photo since 2026-05-28 has an ActiveStorage image, so captions never look at the image
evidence: 34 photo(s) imported in the last 7 days have no ActiveStorage attachment, and 0 post(s) in that window were written by the vision path; corpus 339 photos / 141 attached, newest attachment 2026-05-28. Growth::ContentGenerator#import_photo creates photos path-only and PostAutomation::GenerateCaption routes only attached photos to CaptionGeneration::VisionGenerator, so the caption is written from the photo's context text: measured 2026-09-21, the text path described 'rain drumming on the windowpane ... chamomile tea' for a render that shows an autumn street scene with a mug, which the vision path described correctly. The class itself no longer requires an attachment (its guard now accepts a readable local file, spec'd in spec/services/caption_generation/vision_generator_spec.rb), so switching this on is a one-line change to the branch in PostAutomation::GenerateCaption. Measured cost on the live caption host: 15.0s for a 1.1 MB render through gemma3:4b, with PostProcessor already stripping the model preamble and hashtags. NOT flipped by this loop: it changes what a live account PUBLISHES, and the persona's age reading (persona-age-read-youthful) is unresolved -- Tim's call. Closes automatically once a post in the window records generator='vision'.
